{{nihongo|'''Kuronuma Shrine'''|黒沼神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].

It is said to have been enshrined about 1,300 years ago.

=== Overview ===
* Enshrined deities
** Nunakuratamashiki no Mikoto (= 30th emperor {{ill|Emperor Bidatsu|Q316637|qid=Q316637}})
** {{ill|Yamato Takeru|lt=Yamato Takeru|qid=Q461258}} (Yamatotakeru no Mikoto)
* Shrine rank
** Former district shrine

It is one of the candidate shrines for the "Kuronuma Shrine in Shinobu District, Mutsu Province" named in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}, which is also referenced in classical sources.

It is also known for the "Kanazawa no Hayama Gomori" grand festival, designated by Japan as an {{ill|National Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property|Q6573893|qid=Q6573893}}.
At the April annual festival, Kuronuma Shrine Twelve Kagura is performed, which is also designated by Fukushima Prefecture as an important intangible folk cultural property.
